title: WALTEUR integrations manifest
description: Per-build registry of every external dependency. Enforced by integration-proof-gate.sh: no integration may silently mock. Refines §14 layer 5 (external_integrations).

allow_mock_prototype.description: If true, status=mock is permitted — but ONLY for risk_tier low|medium, and ONLY while prototype_expires is in the future. A time-boxed, owned, auditable trapdoor; never silent.

prototype_expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Required when allow_mock_prototype:true; the gate FAILS once past.

env_keys.description: Env var NAMES only — never values.

proof.description: REQUIRED when status=live-wired: a real round-trip artifact.

command_output_ref.description: Path to the captured output; must exist and be non-empty, fresher than WALTEUR_INTEGRATION_MAX_AGE_DAYS (default 14).

captured_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO; not in the future, not stale.

deferral.description: REQUIRED when status=signed-deferred: the production-grade, owner-signed defer (survives risk_tier high|regulated).
